payload.title: Suggestion job: reference_suggestions.suggest_for
payload.description:
New src/papyrus_content/reference_suggestions.py:
- Related References: GetVectors(returnData) on the Reference's own reference_summary key (no new embedding), QueryVectors topK (API max) with filter vectorKind=reference_summary, curationStatus accepted; exclude own lineage and anything already current or rejected.
- Concepts: query concept_card + ontology_concept_profile; exclude linked concepts.
- How many: cut at the largest gap between consecutive similarities in the first half (knee); once S2.11's calibrated cut exists, use it instead. No fixed threshold.
- Each kept neighbour -> a suggested SemanticRelation row (S2.1), idempotent.
- Runs when a Reference is accepted (router pass) and on demand (S2.7).
Tests with a fake vector provider: no embedding call is made; rejected never returns; knee cut behaves on synthetic scores.
Owner rules that apply: no fixed caps, day windows or magic thresholds (derive or learn them; bound only by time, cost, context size); decisions go to decision models (Jev / the site Cyclotron), the LLM (GPT-6 Luna) only writes; Gherkin specs (narrative, complete) for every behaviour change; say "idea(s)", never "draft"/"proposed story".
